description: Curated diagnostic position suite for Project Janus v0.33 evaluation audit and feature ablation.

positions.rationale: Initial starting position with perfect symmetry; score should be 0 or small tempo/castling balance.
positions.notes: Both sides possess full castling rights and identical piece placement.

positions.rationale: Symmetrical Four Knights Game; equal material and identical central piece distribution.
positions.notes: Slight tempo advantage for White.

positions.rationale: Symmetrical 3 vs 3 kings and pawns; dead draw with equal material.
positions.notes: Evaluates handling of simplified symmetric pawn structures.

positions.rationale: White is up a full queen; score should exceed +800 cp.
positions.notes: Basic material invariant.

positions.rationale: White is up a full rook; score should be near +500 cp.
positions.notes: Basic material invariant.

positions.rationale: White is missing knight on b1; Black is up a minor piece (-320 cp).
positions.notes: Evaluation from White perspective should be approximately -320 cp.

positions.rationale: White has two bishops (c4, c1) vs Black single bishop (g4); White should gain bishop pair bonus.
positions.notes: Baseline grants +25 cp for bishop pair.

positions.rationale: White has two bishops (c1, c4) vs Black zero/one bishop; tests sign symmetry of pair bonus.
positions.notes: Side to move perspective flips score.

positions.rationale: White has an advanced passed pawn on d5 with no opposing pawns on d/c/e files.
positions.notes: A passed pawn bonus should evaluate this higher than a standard pawn on rank 4.

positions.rationale: White has protected passed pawns (c4 supporting d5).
positions.notes: High endgame conversion potential.

positions.rationale: After ...Bxc3 bxc3, White has doubled c-pawns (c2, c3 or c3, c4).
positions.notes: Doubled pawns generally impede mobility and pawn structure solidity.

positions.rationale: Classical Isolated Queen's Pawn (IQP) on d4; no friendly pawns on c or e files.
positions.notes: IQP provides piece activity but is statically vulnerable.

positions.rationale: No pawns on e-file or d-file; rooks occupying open files control critical entry squares.
positions.notes: Baseline gives rooks flat 500 cp without file awareness.

positions.rationale: Black rook on c8 has a semi-open file (no friendly c-pawn, opposing White pawn on c-file absent).
positions.notes: Pressure on semi-open file against enemy backward pawn.

positions.rationale: White king is awkwardly displaced to e2, preventing castling and blocking pieces.
positions.notes: Baseline only evaluates castling rights (+8 cp), not king exposure.

positions.rationale: White king on g1 safely tucked behind f2, g2, h2 pawn shield.
positions.notes: Positive control for king safety.

positions.rationale: White king on g1 with open g-file; missing g2 pawn creates severe mating attack liability.
positions.notes: Static evaluation should penalize missing shield pawns near king.

positions.rationale: Knight on e5 (8 moves) vs Knight on a1 (1 move).
positions.notes: Baseline already handles this via CENTER_BONUS.

positions.rationale: White bishop on a4 vs c1 bishop; evaluates piece freedom.
positions.notes: Baseline center bonus gives a4 lower score than c4.

positions.rationale: Key squares: White king in front of passed pawn, winning endgame.
positions.notes: Endgame evaluation requires active king participation.

positions.rationale: KQ vs K elementary win; queen + king must drive enemy king to the edge.
positions.notes: Flat material gives +900 cp.

positions.rationale: White pawn on b7, Black pawn on g2; White to move promotes with check or first queen.
positions.notes: Turn determines the winner.

positions.rationale: Scholar's mate threat: 5.Qxf7# is mate in one. Static eval must not override search mate.
positions.notes: Evaluation is near equal statically, but search delivers mate.

positions.rationale: 1.Re8# is immediate back-rank mate.
positions.notes: Search must verify Re8# wins immediately.
